issues.description: The template has a method-name/signature mismatch between Stock and StockIngredient: Stock.java calls stockIngredient.getQuantity() but StockIngredient.java defines retrieveQuantity() instead of getQuantity(). This prevents the template from compiling and contradicts the problem instruction to "add getters for all the private fields" (which implies a getQuantity getter).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the getter name consistent: add a public int getQuantity() method to StockIngredient (or rename retrieveQuantity() to getQuantity()). This aligns with Stock.java and the problem statement expectation for standard getter names and will allow the template to compile.

issues.description: The template defines StockIngredient.retrieveQuantity() but other code (template Stock.java and the solution) expects StockIngredient.getQuantity(). This inconsistent naming for the same conceptual getter (quantity accessor) creates a compile-time mismatch and confuses students about the expected getter naming convention.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template method retrieveQuantity() to getQuantity() (or add a getQuantity() delegating to retrieveQuantity) so the StockIngredient quantity getter follows the standard getX naming and matches usages in Stock.java and the solution.
